messages:
maria: Quick sync thread to finalize the evidence-handshake + retention checklist. Goal: minimal event payload that satisfies SOC2/ISO evidence needs and a BYOK export flow auditors can verify.

jon: Agreed. main constraint: do NOT store plaintext key_id in events. use `keystore_ref` + `receipt_id`. receipts in keystore logs contain key_id and are signed.

tara: Security asks: require `ingest_sig` (HSM-signed), `tamper_hash`, `evidence_category`, `control_ids` (list), `schema_version`. Also require `export_id` when events are bundled for audits.

sam: Ops: runtime will tag `retention_label` at ingest (e.g., standard_180d, enterprise_7y). purge worker enforces retention daily. add `ingest_node` for debugging. export jobs must produce immutable `export_id`.

kevin: Legal: retention overrides must reference an `approval_trace` record (signer, ts, justification). auditors want an immutable chain proof: event -> receipt -> export bundle with signatures and hashes.

maria: sample minimal payload (for PR examples):
```json
{
  "event_type":"inference.response",
  "event_id":"uuid-01a2b3",
  "ingest_ts":"2026-03-15T10:12:00Z",
  "tenant_hash":"sha256:abcd...",
  "retention_label":"standard_180d",
  "keystore_ref":"ks:escrow-x",
  "receipt_id":"rcpt-20260315-77",
  "tamper_hash":"sha256:deadbeef...",
  "ingest_sig":"base64:AAA...",
  "control_ids":["SOC2-CC6","ISO-A.12"],
  "schema_version":"evidence-v2",
  "export_id":"exp-20260315-9"
}
```

jon: I'll update the PR with that sample and add a note about where receipts live and how exports link them. I'll also run a microbench to ensure tagging doesn't add >2% p99.

tara: I'll review control mappings and HSM signing design tomorrow. Security signoff blocked until mapping + signoff doc approved.

kevin: I'll draft a one-pager auditor checklist that maps these fields to verification steps and retention SLAs.

maria: Action items: @jon update PR with sample + receipts flow, @sam add retention + purge tests and perf bench, @tara review control map + HSM doc, @kevin produce auditor checklist. I'll book a 20-min sync with a test auditor next Wed afternoon.

audit-bot: PR #534 opened "evidence-handshake-checklist" by maria. CI: schema lint OK, export integration pending signed receipts.

jon: fixing sample receipts in PR now.

maria: aim to lock fields by Friday so we can include in sprint planning. Ping me if blockers.
